title: Cheetah
summary: A small four-legged robot dog in the spirit of the MIT Mini Cheetah. We are building it from the ground up and teaching it to stand, walk and, one day, run.

title: Cubli
summary: A cube that balances on one corner. Three reaction wheels inside spin up and brake to keep it standing.

title: MiniQ
summary: A miniature Cubli. The same self-balancing cube idea, shrunk down to a fraction of the size.

title: KVM Board
summary: A Linux board the size of a flash drive that works as a KVM. Plug it into a computer and control its keyboard, video and mouse from somewhere else.

title: Lab ASRS
summary: An automated storage and retrieval system (ASRS) for our mechatronics lab: ask for a part and a gantry fetches its bin.

title: Home Agent
summary: An autonomous home run by our own AI agent, hosted on our laptops instead of someone else's cloud.
